verdict.rationale: EBANX is a payments API and platform, not an AI agent or host application, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers does not fit its product role. The evidence shows only Agent Skills and llms.txt guidance meant for outside AI coding assistants. Nothing shows EBANX itself consuming MCP servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
